name: graea
description: Give an LLM eyes on a Telegram bot: MTProto + Telegram Web screenshots + vision reader + DuckDB memory.

human_prereqs.notes: api_id/api_hash from https://my.telegram.org (API development tools) for a SPARE Telegram account, never the human's personal one. `phone` is that spare account's number, needed only for the phone-code handshake. If the human already has a GRAEA_SESSION_STRING from a previous login (see session_export below), phone/the phone-code step can be skipped entirely.

install_cmd: git clone https://github.com/estejosh/graea && cd graea && bash install.sh
install_cmd_no_container: git clone https://github.com/estejosh/graea && cd graea && bash install.sh --no-container

container.note: Replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/graea with the real clone path: MCP clients do not run from the repo directory, and podman bind mounts need an absolute path. Vision endpoint on the host (e.g. Ollama) is http://host.containers.internal:11434/v1 from inside the container, not localhost.

mtproto.watch_stdout_for: GRAEA_LOGIN: waiting for code, write it to <path>
mtproto.human_action: Telegram sends the spare account a login code by SMS/app; ask the human for it ONCE.
mtproto.respond_by: write the code to <path> named in the watched line (e.g. `echo 123456 > data/login-code.txt`), or set env GRAEA_LOGIN_CODE before running instead of writing a file
mtproto.skip_if: GRAEA_SESSION_STRING is already set in .env (see session_export)

web.human_action: scan the QR image at <path> (e.g. data/login-qr.png) with the Telegram app on the spare account: Settings > Devices > Link Desktop Device.
web.respond_by: send the human the PNG at <path>; the QR is re-screenshotted to the same path roughly every 20s until scanned

session_export.prints: a Telethon StringSession on stdout, after `graea login` has been run once anywhere
session_export.use: set GRAEA_SESSION_STRING to this value in .env / any container's env to skip the phone-code handshake there entirely

status.exit_2: not connected/authorized yet — check the `hint` field in the JSON output

doctor.exit_1: see the `problems` array in the JSON output

env.BUGS: comma list of planted bugs, empty = correct behavior

troubleshooting.unauthorized session: GRAEA_SESSION points at a file/StringSession that was never logged in, or was logged in with different api_id/api_hash. Re-run the mtproto login protocol.
troubleshooting.web not logged in: `graea status --json` shows web_logged_in:false. Re-run the web login protocol; GRAEA_WEB_PROFILE must be a persistent, writable directory (bind-mounted, not ephemeral).
troubleshooting.vision unreachable: `graea doctor`'s vision_reachable is false. Point GRAEA_VISION_BASE_URL at a running OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. Ollama), or set GRAEA_VISION_PROVIDER=ocr or =none. From inside the container, the host's Ollama is http://host.containers.internal:11434/v1 (localhost is the container itself).
troubleshooting.empty screenshots: Telegram Web's DOM changed. Patch the SELECTORS dict in graea/visual/web.py — it is the single place selectors live.
troubleshooting.vision pending: vision.error says pending: you are the reader. Look at the returned screenshot image and call graea_submit_reading. Only switch GRAEA_VISION_PROVIDER to an engine if the driving LLM cannot see images.

vision.meaning: the LLM driving Graea reads each step's screenshot image itself and reports back via the graea_submit_reading MCP tool (or POST /reading); no second model needed. Alternatives: openai_compatible (Ollama/vLLM/LM Studio/OpenRouter/OpenAI), anthropic, ocr, none.

check_cmd.note: cheap (24h on-disk cache) and safe to run at the start of every session; also folded automatically into `graea_status`/`graea_status` MCP tool output and into a stderr banner on every non-mcp/serve CLI command.

container.note: or run `graea update` inside the container image itself (it shells out to podman on the host, so prefer running the pull directly on the host as shown here).

update.note: agents should run the check_cmd (or graea_update_check) once at the start of a session, and run update_cmd only when a human tells them to update. Container users always get updates via `podman pull ghcr.io/estejosh/graea:latest`.
